title: capabilities
description: Returns the adapter's capability declaration. Called by Hive once per session at session start; response is cached in cycle state.

abi_version.description: Semver string of the ABI version this adapter implements (e.g., '1.0.0')

hierarchy.description: Story nesting model supported by this adapter

supports_parent_link.description: Whether the adapter accepts parent_id in createStory. Must be false when hierarchy is 'flat'.

supported_states.description: Non-empty list of valid state values accepted by updateStatus

supported_labels.description: Valid label strings for createStory, or null if the tracker accepts arbitrary labels

team_field.description: Field name in the tracker for team/workspace grouping. Null if not applicable.

project_field.description: Field name in the tracker for project/board grouping. Null if not applicable.
